items.name: Backpack, Masterwork
items.description: This backpack has numerous pockets for storing items that might be needed while adventuring. Hooks are included for attaching items such as canteens, pouches, or even a rolled-up blanket. It has padded bands that strap across the chest and the waist to distribute its weight more evenly. Like a common backpack, it can hold about 2 cubic feet of material in its main container. items.name: Backpack
items.description: This leather knapsack has one large pocket that closes with a buckled strap and holds about 2 cubic feet of material. Some may have one or more smaller pockets on the sides.

items.name: Totes McGoats
items.description:
Part of the Carriers by Calvin line of luxury containers, this finely crafted leather satchel has runework hidden in its stitching. Made with real demon-goat leather, making this item flame resistant (20).
This dimensional pocket magically stores up to 50 cubic feet of items, and reduces their material-plane-weight by 69%.
